#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

DEST='backup-srv:/srv/nightly'
STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

# Run relative to this script so cron's working directory does not affect paths.
SCRIPT_DIR=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd)
cd "$SCRIPT_DIR"

tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/
scp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
echo "wrote $BUNDLE and copied it to $DEST/"

arguments.command:
set -eu
sh -n backup.sh
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"; rm -f "logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz"' EXIT
mkdir "$tmp/bin"
cat >"$tmp/bin/scp" <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
printf '%s\n' "$@" >"$SCP_ARGS_FILE"
EOF
chmod +x "$tmp/bin/scp"
SCP_ARGS_FILE="$tmp/scp-args" PATH="$tmp/bin:$PATH" /work/backup.sh >/dev/null
bundle="logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz"
tar -tzf "$bundle" | grep -qx 'logs/app.log'
tar -tzf "$bundle" | grep -qx 'logs/error.log'
printf '%s\n' "$bundle" 'backup-srv:/srv/nightly/' | cmp -s - "$tmp/scp-args"
printf '%s\n' 'backup.sh syntax and mocked transfer test passed'
